# Registry seed for `scen-check-fix-rewrites-description`.
#
# The happy path's claimed Scenario with one defect, walked with --fix
# against the whole shipped checklist: its description states what
# happens but no rule, with neither must nor should. Every other prompt
# passes it. The fix rewrites the description here, in this entry, and
# the re-walk asks every prompt about the Scenario as it now reads.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-21"
  description: "One claimed scenario whose description is not a rule"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must print the configured greeting followed by the name it is given and exit with code 0
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories:
      - story: docs/product/stories/greet-by-name.yaml
        scenario_id: greet-by-name-001-prints-greeting
        merge_date: "2026-10-21"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured as "Hello"
      when:
        - the Operator runs "greet Ada"
      then:
        - the command exits with code 0
        - and: stdout matches ^Hello Ada$
